audit_kind: AI descriptive trace audit, not human annotation or causal evidence
scope: Exactly first three terminal-pass published sanitized development traces, no active/private files, task prompts, gold or heldout artifacts.

methods.tool_count: Unique tool parts from final messages.json only; no additive SSE or pagination counting.
methods.response_bytes: Sum UTF-8 byte lengths of returned text blocks only; not tokens, wire size or billing. No inserted separator bytes.
methods.memory_backend_response_bytes: Backend metric counts canonical JSON of the MCP result envelope, including escaped inner text and isError; independently reconstructed exactly. Distinct from returned text-body bytes.
methods.backend_query_hash: Despite metric name query_sha256, adapter hashes canonical full arguments object (query plus limit); independent audit verifies it.
methods.tool_elapsed: Completed minus ran timestamps. Sums may overlap and are not CPU or end-to-end wall time.
methods.repeated_reads: Report repeat paths separately from overlapping returned native read line intervals. Disjoint slices are not counted as repeated identical/broad reads.
methods.first_write: First native patch/edit/write, not temporary files internally created by test shell commands.
methods.network: Visible tool inputs/commands only; not syscall/packet-level proof and does not audit test subprocess internals.

installed_native_mutation_contract.finding: No prior-native-read freshness tracker or read-first requirement in inspected v2.2.5 patch/edit path. Patch/edit read current Environment.files bytes internally, match chunks/oldString, and authorize writes under file locks.
installed_native_mutation_contract.gpt_tool_selection: Patch plugin context hook removes edit/write for non-oss gpt models other than gpt-4; the trial traces use patch.
installed_native_mutation_contract.memory_tool_effect: MCP memory lookup does not call native read. There is no native-read prerequisite here for it to satisfy. Native reads may still supply current context and surrounding source absent from bounded historical notes.
installed_native_mutation_contract.honest_note_contract: CAMI manual_assertion_source_unchanged authenticates the declared unchanged source for a manual historical excerpt; it does not validate behavioral assertions or supply omitted current surrounding code. Static notes are unchecked_current.

interpretation_limits: Three traces of the same development task are not three independent task samples.
No tuning recommendation, speedup inference or general model-behavior claim is made.
No automatic inference that all native reads after memory are redundant.
An absent post-edit query is not itself a conditional-contract violation without visible post-edit reliance on memory availability.
Published output has undergone credential/email redaction; bytes describe the sanitized text retained for audit.
